summary: Frontend-only testing of GymAxis homepage visual rebuild. All 10 sections render correctly with preserved data-testids. Hero features cinematic gym image, pure white Proxima Nova Extrabold headline, cyan italic Maax Rounded 'Gym Performance', LIVE dashboard preview with glow. Platform Overview has bento grid with image-led card + 6 module tiles. AI Differentiation shows 'The Orb' banner with animated pulsing rings + 5 capability cards. KPI Engine counters animate to -34%, 98.2%, 6.4× in cyan. Social Proof has 6 logo cards with site counts + 2 testimonial cards with cyan quote marks. Security terminal shows LIVE indicators. Mobile viewport (390x844) renders cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
